name: lego-view-count-main
scope: single-scene fixed-step-budget comparison, one training seed
initialization_policy: same image-independent 10000-point cloud for all groups; not SfM
camera_policy: provided ground-truth Blender camera poses; not estimated from sparse input images
checkpoint_policy: final step for every group, no test-driven selection
evaluation_order: train all groups before any formal test evaluation
crop_policy: central 40 percent of ground-truth foreground bounding box, identical crop for all groups
time_measurement: training subprocess wall time including startup and loading; evaluation and export measured separately
model_size_measurement: exported Gaussian PLY bytes; checkpoint bytes also recorded
analysis_limits: one scene and one seed; image-to-image std is not run-to-run uncertainty
